title: Clinical trial start-up
goal: Show regulatory approval, site activation, and recruitment dependencies before first enrolment.

rubric.must: Ethics review visibly precedes site-staff training and site activation.
Site activation visibly precedes opening recruitment, screening, and first-participant enrolment.
The site track visibly runs from site selection through contracts and staff training.
The regulatory track visibly runs from package preparation through submission and ethics review.
Protocol finalised, activate sites, open recruitment, and first enrolment are visibly distinguished as milestones.
A critical path is visibly highlighted through the startup network.
